title: Technician Access Wait and No-Show Fees for CareLine Service Plans
content:
Scheduling desk schedule for the CareLine Service Plans family: how long the technician waits for access at the home before a visit counts as a no-show, how many no-show visits per plan year carry no fee, and the fee for each no-show visit beyond that free count.

| Tier | Technician waits for access | No-show visits per plan year without a fee | Fee for a no-show visit beyond the free count (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 30 minutes | 0 | 79.00 |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 30 minutes | 0 | 79.00 |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 30 minutes | 1 | 59.00 |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 30 minutes | 1 | 59.00 |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 30 minutes | 1 | 59.00 |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 30 minutes | 1 | 0.00 |

### The wait, on both sides (hypothetical arrival)

A technician arrives at 9:00 a.m. The wait on every tier is 30 minutes.

- Access given at 9:20 a.m.: given within the 30-minute wait; the visit is not a no-show.
- Nobody has given access by the end of the 30-minute wait: the visit counts as a no-show.

### The fee by position in the plan year (hypothetical plan years)

| No-show visit in the plan year | CareLine Basic Plan | CareLine Plus Plan | CareLine Estate Plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| First | 79.00 | No fee (within the free count of 1) | No fee (within the free count of 1) |
| Second | 79.00 | 59.00 | 0.00 |
| Third | 79.00 | 59.00 | 0.00 |
